data.title: Palestinian Foreign Ministry Condemns Attacks on Civilian, Economic Facilities in Riyadh
data.content:
Occupied Jerusalem, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The Palestinian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates condemned the attacks on civilian and economic facilities in Riyadh that caused material damage to the King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD).
    The ministry described the attacks as a violation of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's sovereignty, territorial integrity, and property rights, as well as a threat to its security and stability and a breach of international law and the principles of good neighborliness.
    It reaffirmed the State of Palestine's full solidarity with Saudi Arabia, rejected all attacks targeting the Kingdom or undermining its sovereignty, security, and territorial integrity, and expressed support for all measures taken by Saudi Arabia to safeguard its sovereignty and maintain its security and stability.
    The ministry stressed that Saudi Arabia's security and stability are integral to collective Arab national security, warning that continued attacks and further escalation threaten regional and international peace and stability.
    -- SPA
